_TO_BE_RE_BARRED_when_session_A_lands.still_escalate_on: a digest change in ANY of the other 15, and in these two BEFORE the flip. covex-v6-base and covex-v6-rules have no state planner and never read gpu_kv_fraction, so neither hit 6 nor hit 22 can reach them: a movement there is a real escalation.
